def VTask.sumLexLift {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β₁ : Type u_3} {β₂ : Type u_4} {γ₁ : Type u_5} {γ₂ : Type u_6} (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) : α₁ ⊕ α₂ → β₁ ⊕ β₂ → Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := fun a b => match a with
  | inl a =>
    match b with
    | inl b =>
      -- Case: inl a, inl b
      Finset.map (fun x => (x, inl)) (f₁ a b)
    | inr b =>
      -- Case: inl a, inr b
      (Finset.image (fun x => (x, inl)) (g₁ a b)) ∪ (Finset.image (fun y => (y, inr)) (g₂ a b))
  | inr a =>
    match b with
    | inl b =>
      -- Case: inr a, inl b
      ∅
    | inr b =>
      -- Case: inr a, inr b
      Finset.map (fun x => (inr x)) (f₂ a b)
